arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Full precision calculation
nov_1979_total = 1574
nov_1979_interest = 7

nov_1980_total = 1938
nov_1980_interest = 10

nov_1981_total = 2608
nov_1981_interest = 5

# Calculate ratios with full precision
ratio_1979 = nov_1979_interest / nov_1979_total
ratio_1980 = nov_1980_interest / nov_1980_total
ratio_1981 = nov_1981_interest / nov_1981_total

print(f'Nov 1979 ratio: {ratio_1979:.15f}')
print(f'Nov 1980 ratio: {ratio_1980:.15f}')
print(f'Nov 1981 ratio: {ratio_1981:.15f}')

# Find highest and lowest
ratios = {'1979': ratio_1979, '1980': ratio_1980, '1981': ratio_1981}
highest_year = max(ratios, key=ratios.get)
lowest_year = min(ratios, key=ratios.get)

print(f'\\nHighest: {highest_year} = {ratios[highest_year]:.15f}')
print(f'Lowest: {lowest_year} = {ratios[lowest_year]:.15f}')

# Absolute difference
abs_diff = abs(ratios[highest_year] - ratios[lowest_year])
print(f'\\nAbsolute difference (full): {abs_diff:.15f}')

# Round to 5 decimal places
rounded = round(abs_diff, 5)
print(f'Rounded to 5 decimal places: {rounded}')
print(f'As string: {rounded}')
"
